translations.web: “For the Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will bring up a mob against them, and will give them to be tossed back and forth and robbed.
translations.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Bring a mob against them and consign them to terror and plunder.
translations.kjv: For thus saith the Lord GOD; I will bring up a company upon them, and will give them to be removed and spoiled.
translations.asv: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up a company against them, and will give them to be tossed to and fro and robbed.
